title: Week in Orbit
summary: This week, the space sector is navigating a mix of resilience and challenges, from NASA's wildfire avoidance to ULA's financial woes. Meanwhile, the defense tech landscape is buzzing with AI and tactical collaborations.

themes.title: Wildfires and Infrastructure Resilience
themes.body: NASA and ESA facilities in Spain have dodged major wildfire damage, showcasing the importance of strategic location and preparedness. This incident serves as a reminder that even the most advanced space agencies aren't immune to earthly disasters.

themes.title: SpaceX's Ongoing Starship Saga
themes.body: SpaceX has successfully conducted its 13th Starship test flight, continuing its relentless pursuit of orbital dominance. Each test brings them closer, but the road to operational capability remains as bumpy as ever.

themes.title: Financial Strains at ULA
themes.body: United Launch Alliance is grappling with financial challenges stemming from the grounding of its Vulcan rocket. This situation underscores the precarious balance between innovation and fiscal responsibility in the aerospace sector.

themes.title: AI's Growing Role in Defense
themes.body: As interest in defense applications surges, companies like LatConnect 60 are unveiling proprietary AI capabilities. This trend signals a shift where artificial intelligence is not just a buzzword, but a critical component of modern military strategy.
